description: File a D212 with ANAF at formularespv-pf, in the account holder's name: the PDF validate_declaration made, and only that (its SHA-256, size and embedded XML are checked against what was validated). Signs in to formularespv-pf by itself (its own session; SPV e-mails a code), uploads, and answers the index de depunere; then waits for SPV's RECIPISA and downloads it with the DECLARATIE. A filed declaration is a fiscal document: it cannot be withdrawn, only rectified. Requires confirm: true; the same bytes are filed once unless refile. A D100, D300 or D112 PDF is checked and refused as unsupported before anything is sent: ANAF takes those only through e-guvernare.ro, signed with a qualified certificate. Moves money or makes a legal document: the client asks the user to approve each call.

confirm.description: Must be true: a filed declaration cannot be withdrawn, only rectified.

pdf.description: The filing PDF validate_declaration made: a file in your workspace folders (the roots this client shares with the server; without them /tmp/churn-_dr30rs0); a bare name is taken from the first. Taken by path only, byte for byte.

pdf_sha256.description: Its hex SHA-256 as validate_declaration answered it; a mismatch fails and nothing is sent.

refile.description: Send these exact bytes again although they were filed (or sent with no answer) before.

save_dir.description: A folder INSIDE the downloads outbox (e.g. "2026-10"); empty means the outbox itself. A path outside it is refused.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for SPV's RECIPISA (it usually arrives within seconds).

name: submit_declaration
title: File a declaration
